summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests CA-4948 with FOLFOX chemotherapy and a PD-1 inhibitor (nivolumab or pembrolizumab), with or without trastuzumab, in people with unresectable or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal cancer. CA-4948 is taken by mouth twice daily, and mFOLFOX7 and nivolumab are given every 14 days in 14-day cycles; pembrolizumab is given on day 1 of every third cycle for a maximum of 2 years, and trastuzumab is given every 14 days in some arms. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa CA-4948 junto con quimioterapia FOLFOX y un inhibidor de PD-1 (nivolumab o pembrolizumab), con o sin trastuzumab, en personas con cáncer gástrico, de la unión gastroesofágica o esofágico irresecable o metastásico. CA-4948 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, y mFOLFOX7 y nivolumab se administran cada 14 días en ciclos de 14 días; el pembrolizumab se administra el día 1 de cada tercer ciclo durante un máximo de 2 años, y el trastuzumab se administra cada 14 días en algunos brazos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; se trata de un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Advanced unresectable or metastatic adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma of the stomach, gastroesophageal junction, or esophagus.
Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST 1.1.
Known HER2 status if the tumor is adenocarcinoma.
No prior systemic treatment for advanced disease; up to two prior cycles of FOLFOX allowed.
Age 18 or older, ECOG 0 or 1, with adequate blood, liver, and kidney function.
not_for: Current or planned alternative, naturopathic, or botanical cancer treatment (medical marijuana is permitted).
Currently receiving another investigational therapeutic agent.
History of clinically relevant tumor bleeding, or untreated ulcerating tumor.
Interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis grade 2 or higher.
